content_zh:
【开胃小菜上完了，下面给大家上正餐，这两个可是真爱呢，不爱美女爱太妃的赘婿弘历&虚恭水灵恋爱脑如懿，这可是大婚当日的妆造，话不多说，我们上图、上图。】
百度下载
（我对周迅本人没有任何偏见，只是单纯的不喜欢如懿这个人，大家不喜勿喷啊！！）
！！！
看着上首出现的图像，众人不由倒吸了一口凉气，这嘟嘟唇，这迷之微笑、这面容，请问她哪里和水灵沾的上边？弘历该不会是眼瞎了吧？
“九哥，宫里的嬷嬷应该、应该都比她好看吧？”
听着蠢弟弟恍恍惚惚的话，胤禟点了点头道：“你可别侮辱嬷嬷了，人家年轻的时候可比这位强多了，这......”
话还未说完，胤禟就忍不住打了个寒颤，这人的形象实在太辣眼睛了。
“哈哈哈，你们大清的后妃就这水准，怪不得要留金钱鼠尾辫呢，原来是为了遮丑啊！”
听着朱元璋的嘲笑，乾隆强压下心里的愤怒，回怼道：“好歹、好歹我娶的是妙龄女子，你家朱见深还恋母，爱上了自家万奶妈呢。”
见自家贞儿被侮辱，朱见深直接拽着这人的领口，骂道：“睁大你的狗眼看看，我家贞儿审美可比她强多了，哼。”
感受着老朱家嘲讽的视线，皇太极、顺治拉着自家真爱的手，异口同声道：“海兰珠（宛如），爷对不起你啊，居然让你们被这些蠢货玷污了！”
海兰珠（宛如）：......
说实话，如果世人认为皇帝的真爱长这样，那我宁愿不当真爱白月光。
【如懿：弘历哥哥，我刚刚出虚恭逃避选秀，你我是兄弟。】
【弘历：如懿，你来参加我的选秀吧。】
！！！！
“不是，为什么出虚恭？选秀何等庄严肃穆，岂能如此、如此污秽？”
“就是啊，装病不行吗？弘历，真没想到你这么重口味，居然喜欢这种的，还有她脖子上那是什么玩意，上吊绳吗？。”
“正常了，弘历这是随根，老四的真爱的青楼舞姬，弘历喜欢老太妃也没什么的，反正都不是什么正常玩意。”

......
听着自家兄弟们你一言我一语的议论，老大胤禔忍不住破防了，抱着自家老头子的腿，哭诉道：“汗阿玛，求您休了额娘吧，儿子求您了。”
众人：？？？
不是，直郡王（大哥）是疯了吗？让阿玛休额娘，这是人干的事？惠妃娘娘当年少给他生了个脑子吧？
康熙直接踹开了这人，咬牙道：“老大，你说什么？你再说一遍？”
“儿子绝不能让额娘的名声形象被带累，求您成全。”
反应过来的其他人不由在心里暗骂这人鸡贼，他们怎么就没想到这一点呢？
“汗阿玛，儿子也为额娘求和离书，您......”
“哈哈哈哈，康麻子，要不你也别一份份写和离书了，毕竟你后宫那么多人，直接休了全部，做个真正的孤家寡人，这多好啊。”
被吵得头疼的康熙见此，忍不住瞪了对方一眼，骂道：“朱元璋，你就不能必闭上自己的那张臭嘴吗？我爱新觉罗家的事，与你何干？”
“啧啧、我这是好心，你居然还不领情，当真是没礼貌。”
太子看着场上的热闹，勾了勾嘴角道：“想要和离书，找我啊，和离书，休夫书......，我这应有尽有，只要你让我满意，随你选择。”
老大胤禔：......
都已经是阴曹地府了，为什么你还比我厉害，老子不想求你啊！
【如懿：墙头马上遥相顾，一见知君即断肠。弘历哥哥，我们因曲定情，日后当不负彼此。】
【弘历：我赠你慎赞徽音，最爱的就是这个音字。】
content_en:
[The hors d’oeuvres have been served, let’s serve the main meal. These two are true love, Hongli, the son-in-law who doesn’t like beauties and loves concubines, and Xu Gong, Shuiling, who is in love with Nao Ruyi. This is the make-up for the wedding day. Without further ado, here are the pictures above. 】
Baidu download
(I don’t have any prejudice against Zhou Xun himself, I just simply don’t like Ruyi. If you don’t like her, please don’t criticize her!!)
! ! !
Looking at the image that appeared above, everyone couldn't help but take a breath. This pouty lips, this charming smile, this face, where does she have anything to do with Shui Ling? Could Hongli be blind?
"Brother Ninth, all the aunts in the palace should be prettier than her, right?"
Listening to the stupid brother's words in a daze, Yinzhen nodded and said: "Don't insult grandma. I was much better than this one when I was young. This..."
Before he finished speaking, Yinzhen couldn't help but shudder. The image of this man was so eye-catching.
"Hahaha, you Qing Dynasty concubines are of this caliber, no wonder you have money rat tails, it turns out they are just to cover up your ugliness!"
Listening to Zhu Yuanzhang's ridicule, Qianlong suppressed the anger in his heart and replied: "Anyway, at least I married a young woman. Your Zhu Jianshen is still Oedipus and fell in love with his own wet nurse Wan."
Seeing that his Zhen'er was being insulted, Zhu Jianshen directly grabbed the man's collar and cursed: "Open your eyes wide and see, my Zhen'er's aesthetics are much better than hers, hum."
Feeling the mocking gaze of the old Zhu family, Huang Taiji and Shunzhi took their true love's hand and said in unison: "Hai Lanzhu (Wan Ru), I'm so sorry for letting you be tainted by these idiots!"
Hai Lanzhu (Wan Ru):......
To be honest, if the world thinks that the emperor's true love looks like this, then I would rather not really love Bai Yueguang.
[Ruyi: Brother Hongli, I just came out to escape the draft. You and I are brothers. 】
[Hongli: Ruyi, come and participate in my draft. 】
! ! ! !
"No, why Xu Gong? The draft is so solemn and solemn, how can it be so, so filthy?"
"That's right, isn't it okay to pretend to be sick? Hongli, I really didn't expect you to have such strong tastes that you actually like this kind of thing. And what is that thing around her neck? Is it a hanging rope?"
"It's normal. Hongli is Sui Gen, the brothel dancer who is the fourth child's true love. It's okay for Hongli to like the old concubine. It's not a normal thing anyway."
...
Listening to the arguments of his brothers, the eldest brother Yinti couldn't help but break his guard. He hugged his old man's legs and cried: "Khan Ama, please divorce my mother, my son is begging you."
Everyone:? ? ?
No, is Prince Zhi (eldest brother) crazy? Asking Ama to have sex with his mother, is this something humans do? Didn't Concubine Hui give him a brain back then?
Kangxi kicked the man away, gritted his teeth and said, "Boss, what did you say? Say it again?"
"My son must not let E Niang's reputation and image be affected. Please help me."
The other people who reacted couldn't help but curse this person in their hearts. Why didn't they think of this?
"Khan Ama, my son also prays for peace and Lishu for E Niang, you..."
"Hahahaha, Kang Mazi, why don't you stop writing divorce papers one by one? After all, you have so many people in your harem, how wonderful it would be to just divorce them all and become a true loner."
Seeing this, Kangxi, who had a headache from the quarrel, couldn't help but glare at the other party and cursed: "Zhu Yuanzhang, can't you just shut up that stinky mouth of yours? What does my love for the Xinjueluo family have to do with you?"
"Tsk, tsk, I mean this well, but you still don't appreciate it. It's really rude."
The prince looked at the commotion on the field, curled up his lips and said: "If you want to make peace with Li Shu, come to me. He Li Shu, divorce letter... I have everything. As long as you satisfy me, it's up to you."
Boss Yinti:...
We are already in the underworld, why are you still better than me? I don’t want to beg you!
[Ruyi: The wall immediately looked at each other from a distance, and as soon as he saw Zhijun, his heart broke. Brother Hongli, we fell in love because of the song, and we will live up to each other in the future. 】
[Hongli: I give you Shenzan Huiyin. This sound is my favorite. 】
